name: Sol
quote: Seek the brilliance of the sun, and clear a path to a brighter future.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: A new day has begun! Let's make the most of it!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: It's afternoon already. Professor, you seem to be working awfully hard.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Let's go have some barbecue!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: What? It's almost midnight. You sure you want to keep working?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Exploration is always full of dangers and challenges. Of course, you've got nothing to worry about with me by your side!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Alsvid and Arvak are my best buddies. Nothing is going to stand a chance against these blades!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: I've got to wake up the Professor somehow. Ah, that's it! A bonk on the head should do the trick!

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Persicaria seems to be busy as always. I wish she would take a break more often.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: You seem quite energetic today, Professor. Should we go explore the sector together?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Haha!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: You seem to be in a good mood. However, perhaps now isn't the best time for jokes...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: You want a taste of my Swiftflame Slash?!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Huh? Is it my turn?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: It's been a long time, Professor. Sol, child of the sun, at your disposal! Leave the exploring and fighting to me!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I feel this strength surging throughout my body!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Nice! Now that I'm stronger, I can clobber any enemies in my way!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: With how much I've improved, I'm ready to face any danger!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I'm ready!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Whoo! I'm on fire!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Eat this!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Enemies destroyed!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Yay!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Is this... the end...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I never thought you'd make such a bold decision... My goodness, you really caught me off guard... W-What I mean is, I'm not going to get all flustered like other girls of my age would. Oh, fine then! I guess I'll accept your proposal! By the way, can we go rock climbing together later?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: It's New Year's Day! To bring in the new year, I got you a surprise gift!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: It's not going to taste as good as ordinary chocolate, since it's from my survival kit... Still, I've put all my heart into it! Please accept it as a token of my gratitude!

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Hmmm, I have no idea what Tanabata celebrates. Either way, I'm happy so long as you are here with me.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Ta-da, it's a freshly baked pumpkin pie! I made it myself from a recipe I found in the data bank. I figured it would be a nice challenge. Give it a try!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Cough, cough...! Who the heck lit a fire in the fireplace? I went through all this effort to dress up as Santa Claus and I even came in through the chimney, then... Cough cough!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: It's too boring to just stay at home and eat cake. To create a truly unforgettable birthday experience, how about we try some more... stimulating activities? Something adults-only, like... hiking or mountain climbing!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Huff... I've been training all afternoon, but the moving targets couldn't catch up with me. I guess we should increase the speed a bit. You can't win a battle without proper training.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Professor, have you ever been trained in swordsmanship? It takes more than just speed and strength to be a competent swordsman. The key is to become one with your sword. You have to see the sword as a part of you, an extension of your body, and not just a tool. Haha! Sounds pretty deep, doesn't it?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Actually... Dolls can learn from our experiences just like humans do. It's not enough to rely solely on the powers programmed into us. It's only through perseverance and hard work that we can gain real strength. The same goes for you, Professor! If you'd like, I can teach you how to use a sword. What do you say?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: This is just who I am... I'm a terrible liar, and I can't really fool anyone. Little by little though, I've come to understand my purpose. I'm not only here to protect people, but to help disperse the darkness in their hearts with the sun's warmth and my smile. And you too, professor. If there's anything you're worried about, I'm all ears!

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: I have a question. Do you consider me trustworthy? Someone you can rely on? I'm just asking... I'm sure I have a long way to go until I'm truly a strong warrior, but I'll never give up trying. Some affirmation and encouragement from you will go a long way to keeping me motivated. We can do this, together!

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hahahahaha!

career:
The EG series is a line of combat-type technician Dolls developed by 42Lab. These dolls are built with military-grade hardware and combat capabilities, and each is coded with the professional knowledge of assistant researchers in various fields of study.

EG4.0 is a model specially developed for scientific research work in extremely dangerous environments. These Dolls are designed to protect scientific research teams during their research in various places, and to provide technical assistance when it's necessary to complete tasks that require a certain level of professional knowledge. The reliable performance and friendly personality of these dolls have been well received by the scientific research teams they've worked with.

As a Doll developed by 42Lab, Sol was among the first dolls selected to participate in the testing of Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
Despite having the title of a technician doll, Sol herself has no interest in tech-related affairs. Most of the combat-type technician dolls would aim to improve their technical skills; if they could pass the designated tests, they will have an opportunity to become researchers, with a safer working environment and a lesser workload.

Only Sol did the exact opposite. Even when she had the opportunity to participate in scientific research projects, she always prioritized projects where she could polish her combat skills. That was how she met Persicaria.

In the "Optimization of Doll's Self-learning Mechanism" project, Persicaria had updated and iterated Sol's neural system, so that she could record the data of each training and battle in more detail, and adjust the parameters of her body accordingly. Since then, Sol had spent all her off time in the training ground, thinking only about how to improve her combat prowess even more.

Once the scientific researchers she was familiar with offered to tutor her, wanting to help her out of the dangerous job she had as soon as possible, but Sol turned them down. She was quite happy with her position.

"We will always need someone to be able to fight, right? I'll be that someone! I will protect you all."
—Transfer Intention Survey on Combat-type Technicians

Sol acts with a mature mannerism on most occasions, especially during fights. Her imposing figure on the battlefield evokes an inexplicable sense of reassurance in many.

With her friends, however, Sol is just a hot-blooded overgrown kid. Her two High-Voltage Taser Blades, named "Arvak" and "Alsvid", are perfect proofs of that.

"Hey, check out the names of my blades! Cool, aren't they?"
"Huh? So those are the names of two horses from mythology stories?"
"It doesn't matter! Cavalry horses are cool too, haha! Arvak, Alsvid! Charge forwards like the cavalry you are!"
"Uh... It won't light up now? Ahaha... I'm sorry, you're not done fixing them yet, right? Sorry, I got a bit too excited."
—An excerpt from the arms maintenance record

The main characteristic that sets Sol apart from the ordinary combat dolls is how she never gives up. Most combat dolls entirely depend on their data module's calculations to make decisions in times of crisis. Once the chance of winning is determined to drop below a certain threshold, they will choose to retreat. Or in human terms, they only fight the fights they can win.

But Sol was different. Sol never learned to admit defeat, and she never backed off from any opponent. Perhaps she was reckless, but this recklessness defined her. That's why she could protect her team members from death several times, and that's why she was always able to fight a way out of the most desperate situations with her team.

Right before taking part in the testing of Project Neural Cloud, Sol completed her last escort mission and bid farewell to the scientific research team. As she was packing up to leave in her dormitory, Sol found herself surrounded by a group of people—all of them from the various teams she had worked with in her city.

They "kidnapped" Sol and took her to a hotel, where they were hosting a farewell party prepared for Sol.

At the farewell party, people who had worked together with her in various scientific research teams gave her gifts one after another. If she ever felt like leaving 42Lab, she would always be welcomed to join their teams again, they said. They valued Sol because she had saved their lives, and more importantly because of her light-hearted and carefree personality. Sol had won their affection with her charisma, not her combat prowess.

Among all the gifts she received that day, Sol's favorite was a bottled firefly. The warm orange light it emitted was faint, but it dispelled a little bit of darkness nevertheless. Although she had released the firefly right after the farewell party, she kept the small bottle around her neck, as if she could still feel that tiny bit of warm light in this way.

After learning about Project Neural Cloud from Persicaria, Sol volunteered to join the test. She uploaded herself to the cloud for a simple goal—to become stronger.

Project Neural Cloud created backups of Dolls' Neural Clouds. If the plan went well, Sol would have infinite lives like in the video games on the cloud, and then she could fight without any worries. Death would no longer be a threat to Sol; it would only be her chance to become stronger—which was especially true since she had no pain sensory system.

The fact that Sol could not feel pain was not known by many. She did not want to make her companions worry about her in battle because of this. She didn't feel her injuries as much as the ordinary Dolls, which enabled her to always push forward fearlessly, to the point of having been injured to the verge of death several times. She worried about her companions more than herself—she always fought for others rather than herself.

If Project Neural Cloud turned out to be a success, then she would become a stronger protector as long as she overcame her insignificant fear of death. According to her, that was the best decision she could ever make.
oathDesc: You shine on others, I'll shine on you.

projections.name: Fearless Explorer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"She will be the light that illuminates the path to hope, burning herself to light up the darkness."

projections.name: Fearless Explorer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"She will be the light that illuminates the path to hope, burning herself to light up the darkness."

projections.name: Pride of the Sun
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Her smile is more dazzling than the blazing sun, and we will follow her through any hardship."

skinList.name: Winternight Sun
skinList.desc:
[Christmas Eve Invitation Series]
Wearing a festive-themed outfit lends a sense of ceremony to tonight's encounter.
"Oh, you made it, huh? No need to rush, come warm yourself up!"
The warmth spreading from her palms drives away the winter chill.

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"This apology position is kind of familiar... Persicaria? Persicaria, why are you just watching?"

skinList.name: Mysterious Warrior S
skinList.desc:
The image that Sol took on when taking part of Burbank's festivities. Guided for light, she fought to dispel the darkness, protecting everyone's future.
 "This light shall be conveyed to the hearts of all."

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"It's a deal, then! Make sure you stick close to me from now on and don't get lost!"

skinList.name: Aromatic Ginger Cookie
skinList.desc:
Revel in a rare moment of relaxation on a sunny, lazy afternoon. As you open the door, the sugary scent of leisure hits you.
Even the self-proclaimed never-tiring explorer must occasionally doze off. When you see Sol, pajama-clad, stretched upon her bed still half asleep, don't think of it as anything weird.

skinList.name: Burgeoning Warmth
skinList.desc: A Doll's first awakening is akin to a human's birth and is of great importance to them. Memories, replicated in Magrasea with Neural Projection—"Haha, you woke me up, right? You've got a good eye! Let's get started after I sort out my hair. We'll have to work hard together!"
